{{Top|leg}}
'''Cloud-jumpers''' were an elite unit of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Exocron Airfleet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exocron]]. It was organized into [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] that were stationed aboard vessels of the Airfleet. Cloud jumpers utilized [[repulsorlift personal jump pack]]s for insertion and extraction during combat missions.
